review.semantics: Conservative source-call projection, not observed runtime topology. Direct edges identify syntactic calls; possible edges include calls inside anonymous callbacks and named function value references. Dynamic targets and external builtins remain explicit boundaries. No control-flow, invocation frequency, callback scheduling, or dataflow proof is claimed.

nodes.source: compare = (sumUnits: bigint) => d * sumUnits ** 2n - n * (2n * denominatorUnit) ** 2n
digest = (x: unknown) => oracleHash(canonical(x))
equal = (a: unknown, b: unknown) => canonical(a) === canonical(b)

binding: Check = (v) =>
	fields(v, {
		packRef: ref,
		sourceDigest: digest,
		runtimeDigest: digest,
		destinationRef: ref,
		compositionEpoch: number(undefined, 1),
		hostEpoch: number(undefined, 1),
		runRef: text(),
		evidenceMode: literal("fixture-observations"),
	})

receipt: Check = (v) =>
	fields(v, {
		receiptRef: ref,
		issuerRef: ref,
		verifierRevision: text(),
		occurrence,
		inputDigest: digest,
		policyDigest: digest,
		sourceDigest: digest,
		runtimeDigest: digest,
		requestDigest: digest,
		numericDomainRef: text(),
		verdict: literal("pass", "fail", "unavailable"),
		artifactRef: ref,
		artifactDigest: digest,
	})
ref: Check = (v) => fields(v, { kind: text(), id: text() })
digest = (value: unknown) => oracleHash(canonical(value))
equal = (a: unknown, b: unknown) => canonical(a) === canonical(b)
oracleHash = (s: string) => `sha256:${createHash("sha256").update(s).digest("hex")}`
